added_abstractions.availability: H1-H4 are available as prospective test designs. H5 is unavailable in the current benchmark because the source dossier reports no direct UAP-tachyon link/source-linked event suitable for that bridge gate.
added_abstractions.cause_class_coarsening: JANUS-added planning abstraction over source lanes; not a source claim that these four classes exhaust reality.
added_abstractions.cost_model: All available tests use unit cost so the solver minimizes witness count only; no empirical monetary/time/resource cost is asserted.
added_abstractions.pairwise_discrimination_edges: JANUS interpretation of what a successful source gate is designed to distinguish at this coarse cause-class level; every edge remains conditional on valid prospective execution.

gate_mappings.benchmark_semantics: A preregistered independent pre-event effect surviving leakage controls can separate the ordinary/leakage null from the three retro-information hypotheses at this coarse level. It does not distinguish the three retro-information hypotheses from one another and does not itself prove retrocausality.
gate_mappings.source_design: Freeze target generator, scoring rule, lag window, sample size and stopping rule before future targets exist; test pre-target responses against an exact/permutation null on independent holdout.
gate_mappings.source_falsifier: Effect disappears on holdout or after leakage controls.

gate_mappings.benchmark_semantics: Temporal-kernel preregistration is retained as a validity/control witness. The dossier does not supply a carrier-specific temporal kernel that would justify a hard pairwise cause-class edge here.
gate_mappings.source_design: Predeclare allowed lag kernel/family before seeing outcomes.
gate_mappings.source_falsifier: Peak exists only after choosing the best lag post hoc.

gate_mappings.benchmark_semantics: The dossier explicitly frames this gate as separating information-selection/decision structure from force-like physical-system models. It does not by itself identify which physical carrier exists.
gate_mappings.source_design: Vary human decision opportunities independently from physical generator parameters to separate information-selection from force-like models.

gate_mappings.benchmark_semantics: Only an independently observed tachyon-specific physical signature can separate the tachyon-carrier claim from generic/non-carrier alternatives. An anomalous p-value alone is explicitly insufficient.
gate_mappings.source_design: Any tachyon-carrier claim requires a carrier-specific physical observable independent of anomalous statistics.
gate_mappings.source_falsifier: Only an unusual p-value exists, with no tachyon-specific signature.

gate_mappings.benchmark_semantics: Cross-domain extension only. The current source reports no direct UAP-tachyon-retrocausality link and no completed byte-level NARA bulk null, so this gate cannot be used to promote the core retrocausal cause classes.
gate_mappings.source_design: Require a source-linked UAP event with a preregistered temporal/physical signature and control corpus; thematic proximity is insufficient.
gate_mappings.source_falsifier: Link exists only through shared vocabulary or archive adjacency.
